title: Battle of Kassala
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Kassala", at revision 1370444899, opens: "The Battle of Kassala was fought on July 17, 1894, between Italian colonial troops and Mahdist Sudanese forces." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3636373, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1894 military engagement". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
